'''Goh's Cubone''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのカラカラ''' ''Go's Karakara'') is the fifteenth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his twenty-eighth overall.

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|JN}}====
[[File:Goh and Cubone.png|thumb|left|250px|Cubone and Goh]]
In ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]'', [[Goh]] encountered {{p|Cubone}} while visiting his family. It was surrounded by a group of {{p|Mankey}}, although {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}} gets involved in the battle, his bone is stolen by the Pokémon group. Sad at the loss of the item, Goh tried to console him, and soon after that Goh decided to use his Pokémon to find the missing bone. After meeting the Mankey again and seeing that they also lost the bone, another search began, where Goh's {{p|Butterfree}} found a {{p|Fearow}} who knew the location of the lost item. Towards the end of the day, Cubone, Goh, and Ash discovered that it was on the bottom of a lake and,  thanks to [[Goh's Dewgong]], they succeeded to recover it. Goh returned the bone to Cubone and, after meeting Goh's parents, the Pokémon allowed itself to be caught by him. At Goh's house, Cubone was seen on the lap of his {{pkmn|Trainer}} and having fun with the other Pokémon in the apartment.

In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', it was revealed that Cubone befriended [[Goh's Skwovet]]. The two called {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} to stop the other Pokémon from fighting during a food shortage. When Golurk's seal fell off and it went berserk, Cubone helped put the seal back on. It then helped protect the {{p|Cascoon}} from the flood caused by Golurk's rampage, allowing them to evolve into {{p|Dustox}}.
[[File:Goh Cubone upset.png|thumb|250px|Cubone upset over its missing bone]]
In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', Goh used Cubone along with other Pokémon to create a fountain so that {{p|Grimer}} and {{p|Froakie}} could live in [[Cerise Laboratory]] without dirtying the stream where some of the Pokémon live.

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Cubone attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

===Personality and characteristics===
Cubone is shown to become very upset when it loses its bone, as seen in ''[[JN015|A Snow Day for Searching!]]'' when it was taken by a group of Mankey. This caused it to cry out loud and only calmed down once its bone was retrieved. This caused Cubone to be thankful, as seen when it asked to join [[Goh]]'s team after he helped retrieve it.

Cubone is often seen next to [[Goh's Darmanitan]], whether interacting with him or following his training with [[Goh's Heracross]].

==In the games==
===[[Pokémon GO]]===
On November 6, 2020, as part of Pokémon GO's [https://pokemongolive.com/en/post/animationweek2020/?hl=en Animation Week 2020] event, which was based on {{aniseries|JN}}, several Pokémon based on those that Ash and Goh encountered in the animated series appeared more frequently in the wild, in [[Raid Battle (GO)|raids]], from 7 km [[List of Eggs in Pokémon GO|Eggs]], and during [[Photography#Pokémon GO|surprise encounters]], with Cubone appearing more frequently in the wild and in 7 km Eggs. The event ran from November 6, 2020, at 8:00 a.m., to November 12, 2020, at 10:00 p.m. local time.
